[[File:Feyische avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Feyische.]]
'''Feyische''' is an artist whose image is used on four [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Feyische @ DeviantArt". The credit points to DeviantArt, an online art community. The credited cards are [[Captain Hera Syndulla|•Captain Hera Syndulla]], [[Captain Hera Syndulla (ALT)|•Captain Hera Syndulla (AI)]], [[Captain Hera Syndulla (Border Breaker AI)|•Captain Hera Syndulla (Border Breaker AI)]], and [[This Is MY Ship!|•This Is MY Ship!]], in [[Virtual Set 4]] and [[Virtual Set 7]] (released 2016–2017).
